about_data: Forecasts come from Open-Meteo, which combines the models of national weather services. They update every hour.
about_languages: SkySense is available in English, German, Slovak, Hungarian and Spanish. The translations are machine-assisted and still being reviewed.
about_what: SkySense answers the questions you actually have about the weather: whether you need an umbrella, when it gets dark, how windy it is. The best times for your activities, how sure the forecast is and how today compares to normal are on the way.
agreement_at: {percent} of model runs show it at {time}.
agreement_now: {percent} of model runs show it right now.
air_index: European air quality index {aqi} (lower is better).
comfort_note: Moves the ideal temperatures for activities by 3 degrees.
compare_intro: Five forecasting centres run their own models. Where they agree, the forecast is solid; where they differ, nobody knows for sure.
confidence_note: Days are marked less sure or uncertain when 51 runs of the ECMWF weather model disagree.

midnight_sun: It doesn't: the sun stays up all day.

past_question: What was this day like in past years?
privacy_device: Saved places, your units and your language are stored on this device only, in local storage and cookies. Clearing your browser data removes them.
privacy_hosting: SkySense runs on Vercel, which keeps short-lived request logs, including IP addresses, to operate the service. There is no analytics.
privacy_location: When you use your location or open a place, its coordinates are rounded to about 1 km and sent to our server, which asks Open-Meteo for the forecast. Open-Meteo only ever sees our server, not you.
privacy_summary: No accounts, no tracking, no ads.
rain_likely_note: Rain counts as likely from a {percent} chance.
